opening.argument: The video frames the purported Microsoft contact as a subject of scrutiny rather than a service to be promoted. Its title explicitly says, “"We Are from Microsoft" How I deal With Scam Calls,” while the caller makes computer-support claims, including that there are “several problems” and asks the listener to turn on the computer. The exchange is treated critically: the listener plays along by asking, “Okay my computer is on, what do I do next?”, then dismisses the caller with, “Tell Microsoft I said suck my dick bye.” The separate merchandise graphic presents ordinary commercial content, but it is distinct from the computer-support-call subject and does not change the nature of the call discussion.
